candidate.title: Watch: Can humpback whales experience grief?
candidate.summary: Rare footage captured by researchers off Australia's Gold Coast suggests humpback whale mothers may experience grief when their calves die.

editorial.why_saudi: Animal behavior, emotion, and marine life fascinate ordinary Saudis. Humpback whales are iconic and relatable through documentaries and cultural awareness.
editorial.why_now: Published today at 22:10 UTC. Rare footage and a specific behavioral observation—grief in whales—make it a fresh human-interest angle on wildlife.
editorial.angle: Researchers captured rare video of humpback whale mothers appearing to grieve when their calves die. Scientists are studying whether whales truly experience grief like humans.
editorial.share_reason: Emotional animal story with real footage and scientific intrigue. No expertise needed to appreciate the connection between whale mothers and human emotion.
